page_title: CRY 3-1 BRE | Crystal Palace v Brentford 30/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's it for today, Robert Jones has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+4' A corner kick by Crystal Palace is thwarted by the well prepared Mark Flekken (Brentford).
90+4' Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
90+2' A substitution has been made. Jordan Ayew is replaced by Jeffrey Schlupp (Crystal Palace).
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
88' Robert Jones blows his whistle for a foul after Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford) hacks down one of his opponents.
86' Roy Hodgson decides to make a substitution. Jean-Philippe Mateta will be replaced by Matheus Franca (Crystal Palace).
86' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Eberechi Eze.
86' Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
85' Frank Onyeka (Brentford) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
84' Saman Ghoddos (Brentford) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Dean Henderson intercepts the ball.
83' Brentford have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
82' Ethan Pinnock (Brentford) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. Brentford will take a corner kick.
81' Brentford take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
81' A cross from a corner kick by Brentford is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
80' Here is a change. Keane Lewis-Potter is going off and Thomas Frank gives the last tactical orders to Michael Olakigbe (Brentford).
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford) replaces Vitaly Janelt.
80' Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Robert Jones blows for a foul.

77' Vitaly Janelt swings in an inviting cross that finds Yoane Wissa (Brentford). He doesn't take advantage as his effort goes harmlessly over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Crystal Palace.
76' Neal Maupay (Brentford) gets into a shooting position! What a long-range cannonball of a shot! His nice effort, however, only crashes against the crossbar. Aim better, sir.
76' Rough tackle by Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
74' Dangerous play by Zanka (Brentford). Robert Jones blows his whistle for a foul.
73' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) decided to shoot after receiving a sweet pass. The ball went low to the middle of the goal, but Mark Flekken made a easy save.
72' Robert Jones interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Ethan Pinnock (Brentford).
69' Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.

68' The Brentford players are exchanging some short passes and control the game at the moment, but one of the defending players steps in and intercepts the ball. The ball goes out of play. Brentford are awarded a corner kick.
67' The substitution is prepared. Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Christian Norgaard.

67' Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) unleashes a cannonball of a shot from the edge of the area, but it zips narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Brentford will have a goal kick.
67' Nathan Michael Collins (Brentford) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
65' Chris Richards (Crystal Palace) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
63' Thomas Frank has decided to make a change. Frank Onyeka (Brentford) replaces Mads Roerslev Rasmussen.
63' Substitution. Neal Maupay (Brentford) in, Mathias Jensen out.
62' Robert Jones blows his whistle as Yoane Wissa (Brentford) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.

58' 3 - 1 Goal! That was a fantastic finish by Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) from just outside the box. He wasted little time in getting away a bullet of a shot that flew past the goalkeeper into the bottom left corner of the net.

58' Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) found himself in a promising position. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a shot from just outside the penalty area which went towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper was ready and made a decent save.
57' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Mark Flekken intercepts the ball.
55' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.

53' Chance! Christian Norgaard (Brentford) gets to the rebound on the edge of the box and smashes the ball towards the bottom right corner, but Dean Henderson is alert and makes a great save to deny him.
52' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
51' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Crystal Palace force their opponents to concede a corner.
50' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) sends a cross into the box, but Mark Flekken comes off his line to gather the ball.

48' Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the resulting corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Brentford will have a goal kick.
48' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) will deliver the corner kick.
48' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. The ball goes out of play and Crystal Palace have been awarded a corner kick.
47' Nathaniel Clyne (Crystal Palace) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
47' Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+7' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+7' Crystal Palace can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

45+7' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Crystal Palace.
45+6' Robert Jones blows his whistle and it's Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.

45+6' Brentford exchange some short passes over a small area and control the game. Now they make a mistake and lose the ball and the whole situation changes completely. The ball is out of play. Crystal Palace will take a throw-in.
45+2' Saman Ghoddos (Brentford) will miss the next game.
45+2' Saman Ghoddos (Brentford) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
45+2' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Crystal Palace.
45' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
45' Neat link-up play between Mads Roerslev Rasmussen (Brentford) and Yoane Wissa, but Dean Henderson reads the game well and the move breaks down.
44' Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) is able to continue to play.
42' Looks like Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
42' Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) unleashed a powerful long-range strike, but the ball was blocked by a defender on its way.

39' 2 - 1 A superb goal from great team play! Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) latches on to a perfect pass and fires an excellent low shot inside the right post. There is nothing a goalkeeper can do about shots like that.
38' Neat link-up play between Mathias Jensen (Brentford) and Keane Lewis-Potter, but Dean Henderson reads the game well and the move breaks down.
38' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) serves up a nice cross, but Dean Henderson punches the ball away.
38' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Robert Jones saw the whole situation.
37' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) offside.
36' Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Mark Flekken, who smothers the ball.

35' Joachim Andersen (Crystal Palace) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brentford.

32' Crystal Palace hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
30' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Crystal Palace for a penalty. Play continues.
29' Christian Norgaard (Brentford) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Robert Jones has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.

28' Nathan Michael Collins (Brentford) jumps highest to meet an accurate cross and heads the ball towards the net. His fine header whistles just inches wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Crystal Palace will have a goal kick.
27' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
27' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
26' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. Brentford earn a corner.
24' Crystal Palace keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
21' Mads Roerslev Rasmussen (Brentford) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
21' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
20' Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Crystal Palace.

19' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) wastes a huge opportunity! He receives a precise cross inside the penalty area and produces a low shot that sails towards the middle of a goal. His effort, however, lacks power and the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
18' The ball is cleared after Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out of play and Brentford will have a goal kick.
17' Marc Guehi (Crystal Palace) makes a strong challenge and Robert Jones blows for a foul.

17' Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Mark Flekken makes a comfortable save to stop the effort from flying into the middle of the goal.
16' Zanka (Brentford) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee.
14' 1 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Jordan Ayew plays it into the box, and Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) gets on the end of the cross to put it into the back of the net. 1:1.
12' Mads Roerslev Rasmussen (Brentford) is penalised for a foul. Robert Jones had a clear view and blows his whistle.
11' Crystal Palace fail to score from a corner as Mark Flekken (Brentford) leaps to collect the ball.

11' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Crystal Palace. Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
9' Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) commits a foul during an attacking move.

8' Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball is out of play. Crystal Palace will have a throw-in.
7' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Robert Jones who sees an offensive foul.
6' Robert Jones sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
3' The Brentford players halt their celebrations as referee Robert Jones makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.

2' 0 - 1 Mads Roerslev Rasmussen sends a precise lofted cross into the box. Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) latches on to it and finishes with a quick shot inside the right post. The goalkeeper had no chance. The score changes to 0:1.
1' The first half has just begun.
Crystal Palace will kick the game off.
Robert Jones is the one to supervise the game today.
